description: This is a code-behind file for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named ShowAns.aspx. It handles displaying and submitting students' theory answers and marks, interacting with a SQL database to retrieve and update answer data, and managing session-based navigation.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for the ShowAns ASP.NET page managing displaying and submitting student answers.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page initialization; retrieves students' answers for questions 1 to 5 from the database and populates relevant UI controls.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates answer record with marks, removes student from course queue, and redirects to AdminCourseQueue.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to LoginPage.aspx.
